tooltips.walletApplePassTypeId: Identifier registered in Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles, e.g. pass.com.example.loyalty.
tooltips.walletAppleWebServiceUrl: Leave empty to use <public URL>/api/v1/WalletService. Must be HTTPS.
tooltips.walletApplePushType: Wallet updates normally need no apns-push-type header. Use "background" only if APNs rejects the push with InvalidPushType.
tooltips.walletAppleCertificate: Pass Type ID certificate exported from Keychain with its private key. Stored encrypted in data/wallet-passes/.
tooltips.walletAppleWwdr: Optional: Apple WWDR G4 intermediate (.cer). The G4 certificate bundled with the library is used otherwise.
tooltips.walletGoogleIssuerId: Google Pay & Wallet Console → Google Wallet API → Issuer ID.
tooltips.walletGoogleOrigins: Domains allowed to show the "Add to Google Wallet" button, e.g. https://crm.example.com.
tooltips.walletGoogleServiceAccount: JSON key of a service account added as user of the issuer account. Stored encrypted.
tooltips.walletPublicBaseUrl: Public HTTPS URL of EspoCRM used in links and QR codes. Defaults to the Site URL.
